name: B10-0117/2024 (PPE) – The cases of unjustly imprisoned Uyghurs in China, notably Ilham Tohti and Gulshan Abbas
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of unjustly imprisoned Uyghurs in China, notably Ilham Tohti and Gulshan Abbas
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It asks China to release two imprisoned Uyghurs: Ilham Tohti, a scholar jailed for life in 2014, and Gulshan Abbas, a retired doctor jailed for 20 years in 2019. It also asks China to stop its repression of Uyghurs and other groups, and asks the United Nations to set up a body to investigate rights abuses in China.

- Nothing changes yet; the Parliament only asks China to free Tohti and Abbas.
- The two prisoners and their families are affected, plus Uyghurs in Xinjiang.
- Next, the text goes to EU governments, the United Nations and China.
